sections.name: Our Famous ½ lb. Ambergers
sections.description: All of our burgers are charbroiled. Half-pound beef, on your choice of a white or wheat toasted bun. Platters include a choice of one side item. Onions are no charge. Cheese: real cheddar, real Swiss, real pepper jack. Sandwich / platter.

items.story: Olives on a half-pound burger. It reads like a mistake and eats like it was always supposed to be there. Black or green, your call, under real Swiss. Ask the bar how long it has been on the menu; nobody agrees.

items.name: Peanut Butter Burger
items.description: Bacon on top and bottom, a thin layer of peanut butter on the burger. Tuesday special. One of Visit Eau Claire's ten iconic Eau Claire eats.
items.story:
People hear the name and stop. Then they order it again the next time they are in.

Bacon on top and bottom, a thin layer of peanut butter on the half-pound patty, so it runs into the bacon while it is hot. That is the whole trick.

It is the Tuesday special, and Visit Eau Claire put it on their list of ten iconic Eau Claire eats.

sections.name: Beverages
sections.description: Domestic and import beer on tap and in bottles, in mugs, pints and pitchers. Happy hour Monday through Friday, 4 to 6 PM. See what is pouring on the tap wall.

items.name: Draft Root Beer
items.description: Sprecher root beer on tap, in a frosted mug. Still on the taps, the way it was in 1920 — George Berg Soft Drinks Co.
items.story: Root beer has poured in this room since 1920, when Prohibition turned the bar into George Berg Soft Drinks. A century later it is still on tap, in a frosted mug, for the kids and for anyone who remembers.
